channel.title: Expo incidents — Vendor Status Watch
channel.description: Incidents from Expo's public status page, polled daily.

item.title: iOS push notification degraded performance [resolved]
Delayed iOS push notification delivery [resolved]
Delayed and failed submissions due to issues with build artifacts [resolved]
Elevated Linux worker queue times [resolved]
Degraded performance on the NPM registry [resolved]
item.description: This incident has been resolved. NPM has restored registry performance. Package installs and EAS Builds using NPM should now complete as expected.

item.title: Elevated Android builds rate [resolved]
Elevated Linux worker queue times [resolved]
item.description:
A fix was deployed at 2:50pm PT/5:50pm ET. The job queue has been running as expected.
The root cause of this incident is that a new version of a cache needed more vCPUs than it was given, and we have increased the CPU count as the immediate fix along with additional monitoring for CPU usage on these cache instances.

item.title: Problems with API and website availability [resolved]
item.description: Our cloud provider's network is fully operational in all of the availability zones Expo uses.

item.title: EAS background operations availability issues [resolved]
iOS submissions failing on upload to App Store Connect [resolved]
iOS Submissions hanging on App Store Connect build uploads [resolved]
iOS Submissions hanging on App Store Connect build uploads [resolved]
EAS CLI broken in some workflows [resolved]
item.description: Fix deployed to server, `eas-cli@22.0.0` set back to `latest`.

item.title: EAS Update degraded availability [resolved]
Expo Go and Dev Client login outage [resolved]
Increased EAS Update manifest error rates [resolved]
item.description: At around 4 PM PDT, we experienced a temporary spike in EAS Update manifest serving errors. Service reliability has returned to normal, and we are monitoring the situation.

item.title: Increased error rates for Android on EAS Submit [resolved]
Increased error rates and processing times for EAS Build and EAS Submit on Android [resolved]
iOS Push Notifications partial outage [resolved]
Elevated Android build failures [resolved]
item.description:
This incident is resolved. Android builds are completing normally.
Some Android builds and Linux workflow jobs failed early with the error "We've lost connection to the worker". Builds and jobs that failed with this error were automatically excluded from billing and can be retried.

item.title: Elevated latency for EAS Update manifest requests [resolved]
EAS Submit for iOS is seeing elevated failures due to Apple App Store Connect authentication issues [resolved]
item.description: iOS submission success rates are back to normal as App Store Connect continues to recover. Submissions that failed during the outage won’t be retried automatically — please resubmit those builds.

item.title: High submission times for iOS [resolved]
High submission times for Android [resolved]
Major outage of EAS backend [resolved]
item.description: All services are back to operational.

item.title: Free plan users are getting capped on builds before reaching allowance [resolved]
item.description: It looks like users are not actually getting limited, but are getting a 100% build used warning ahead of time when triggering a build from the eas cli. Use eas-cli@latest for correct messaging.

item.title: Elevated error rates and latency for EAS Build, Workflows, and Submit [resolved]
Elevated error rates and latency for EAS Build, Workflows, and Submit [resolved]
Build and Workflows pages on expo.dev were not scrollable [resolved]
item.description: Between 9:04am PDT and 10:56am PDT, users experienced scrolling issues on the Build and Workflows pages of expo.dev. This was caused by a CSS issue introduced in a recent deployment. We rolled back the deployment and verified the issue is resolved. We apologize for the inconvenience.
